worldcombat.skill.boneclub.summary: A bone swung like a club: it reaches farther than the body. A thrust pokes a single line along the locked direction, while a sweep carves a bone arc from left to right over several ticks; those caught take a non-contact heavy hit and are occasionally staggered, each target only once per swing. Accuracy is only 85, so it does miss, a real wall truncates the bone, and a whiff just knocks dust off the end.
worldcombat.skill.boneclub.description.0: A thrust reaches out as one narrow weapon line along the locked direction; a sweep carves a wide arc. It catches up to %4$s enemies, each struck once for about %1$s non-contact damage; the bone reaches up to %2$s blocks with a %3$s block half-width around the arc/line end. Accuracy is only 85, so the aim really can bend away; the target's defence, type and crits apply on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.boneclub.description.1: It steps %1$s blocks toward the target before swinging.
worldcombat.skill.boneclub.description.2: Each struck target separately has a %1$s chance to be staggered for %2$s: the stagger first tries to interrupt whatever it is doing that can be interrupted, and while staggered it cannot start new moves or make ordinary attacks. A real wall truncates the bone at the tick it touches it, so nothing behind it is hit and only chips of the wall fly off; hitting nothing leaves just a small puff at the end.
worldcombat.skill.boneclub.sweep.on: Sweep form: carves a wide bone arc from left to right over several ticks that can catch two or three side by side, but lighter per target with a slower recovery.
worldcombat.skill.boneclub.sweep.off: Thrust form: one narrow weapon line, higher per target and faster to cast, but easier to whiff.
worldcombat.skill.boneclub.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.boneclub.growth.0: From level %1$s the club power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.boneclub.growth.1: From level %1$s the club power rises to %2$s, the reach to %3$s blocks and the stagger chance to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.boneclub.use.0: Open on a target with a bone that reaches farther than the body
worldcombat.skill.boneclub.use.1: Catch two or three side by side in one sweep
worldcombat.skill.boneclub.use.2: Stagger a foe before it closes in
worldcombat.skill.boneclub.preference.sw: On: carves a wide bone arc from left to right over several ticks that can catch two or three side by side, but lighter per target and slower to recover. Off: a narrow thrust with higher per-target power and a faster cast, but accuracy 85 makes it easier to whiff.
worldcombat.skill.boneclub.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. The bone reaches far, but with accuracy 85 chasing too far often swings for nothing.
On: prefer to swing when the target is outside normal melee but still within reach, using it as a spacing tool. Off: sort it as an ordinary melee move.
